caption:
Mexican Style Beans Recipe

This recipe is vegetarian, vegan friendly and a decent vegetarian source of protein. 
if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond accordingly :) 

Ingredients:
-60 grams Kidney Beans (Rajma), Soaked over night and pressure cooked for 30 minutes
-1 tsp oil / ghee
-1 onion, finely chopped
-2-4 cloves garlic, minced
-100 grams mushrooms, sliced
-half a green capsicum, small chop
Powders:
-1 tsp coriander powder
-1tsp red chilli powder
-1 tsp cumin powder (jeera pwd)
-1/2 tsp salt or as per your taste preference
-1 packet oregano
-1 packet chilli flakes 
Aqua:
-3 tbsp water, just to mix the powders evenly in the rajma mix
Garnish
-coriander leaves for garnish 

Method: 
-ensure you soak your kidney beans over night before making this recipe. 
-the next day, take your soaked kidney beans and pressure cook them with 1 cup pf water and a little salt for atleast 30 minutes.
-add oil or ghee to a pan and add in your onion and garlic -> cook till translucent 
-add in your mushroom and allow that 2-3 minutes to cook then follow up by adding in your capsicum and saute
-add your cooked kidney beans and stir together
-add in all your powders + the aqua and cook for 5-6 minutes
-top with coriander leaves and enjoy :) 

How to eat: 
This can be eaten as part of a mexican bowl or in a quasadilla or taco 
Can be eaten by itself in lettuce cups as a low carb high protein option
